posts.headline: Nine straight editions of dead air and One Nut Barner still hasn't uttered a syllable — Put it in Ra rolls into real Week 1 games with a 20-8 record, a 1.5 average finish, and STILL zero rings to justify the swagger.
posts.detail: Two seasons, best record in the league, and this dynasty-in-waiting has never actually finished the job — the receipts say contender, the trophy case says nothing.

posts.headline: The excuses are officially dead — Big Head's title banner has to survive real football now, not just chatter, and a 13-15 career record isn't going to explain itself.
posts.detail: One ring, a losing overall mark, and a 5.5 average finish — Sasinci's World has been living on reputation for two straight editions and Week 1 is where that runs out.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh finally has real games attached to the name, and the untalented tenth enters carrying the single worst résumé in the entire league into Week 1.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish don't get erased by a fresh roster — they get tested, and this league expects more of the same.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT enters Week 1 still paying penance for drafting a DEFENSIVE player first overall, and the Ultimate Light Skin's 13-14-1 mark says the sinning never stopped.
posts.detail: Two seasons, a 5.5 average finish, and a career record that's basically a coin flip with a stumble — judgment day doesn't end at the draft, Eli, it starts now.

author.name: Easy way or the Hard Way

posts.headline: Easy Way or the Hard Way opens live action still owning a rookie 6-8 record and a dead-last 10th-place finish, and Auntie Thomas hasn't given this league one reason to expect the hard way turns easy.
posts.detail: A bottom-feeder tier is earned, not assigned — one season in the books and it was the 10th-worst finish possible, so prove it on the field or confirm the streak.
